summary: Firefox’s compositor—the part that brings page layers together on screen—got improvements to scrolling, overscroll, fixed-position content, and scroll-driven animations, including when the on-screen keyboard or dynamic toolbar is involved. Other changes improve HDR and color handling on Wayland and macOS and preserve video color information; DRM-protected video frames are also kept out of macOS layer contents when DRM state changes. Texture and synchronization updates across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android help graphics resources work more reliably and be reused efficiently.
